Welcome To
Kamarbandha College
Welcome to the Kamarbandha College. The College was established in 1986. It is situated at Dulakhoria, in the East of Golaghat District and the West of Jorhat district of Assam. It is an institute of higher education in the facilities of Social Science and Computer education and affiliated to the Dibrugarh University. It's like a dream comes true, when with the efforts of the founders, patrons, donors, faculties, students, guardians and management. The College was accorded provincialisation under the Assam Venture Educational Institutions (Provincialisation of Services) Act 2011. It stands on a land, amidst the greenery of tea gardens and a natural environment conducive for education, sports and interactions among people of various fields. The college is promoting a tradition of exellence in teaching and learning. It has successfully produced more than 794 graduates so far and they are well off. It has a safe and secure atmosphere and strict disciplinary measures againsts offences like ragging etc.

We provide
Following facilities
Digital Library
Kamarbandha college library is situated at the central position of the college.The library building is physically large one.
Read More
Computer Lab
The college has a computer lab with 15 Desktop Computers on the first floor of the Digital library building.The primary goals of the computer labs and classrooms is to provide assistance to students that will enhance their chances of succeeding in technology-based classroom assignments and to provide access to equipment that will support the needs of instruction where we celebrate life-long learning.
Boy's/Girl's Common room
Boy's common rooms is spacious and airy. Boy's common room have various indoor game facilities like table tennis, carom and chess.Magazines and newspapers are also arranged in the common room for recreation of students.
NCC
The College has an NCC unit for both boys and girls to promote discipline, help students get jobs and strengthen civil defence.
LAN/WIFI Connection
The College has the internet/Wifi facilities to its users with a BSNL Broadband connectivity. Students, Teachers and employees can use internet for free.
Canteen
The College has one canteen within the campus for refreshment of students and teachers. The canteens usually function from 9 a.m. to 5.15 p.m.The college canteen has separate sitting arrangements for students and faculty members. Various types of good quality food and refreshment are provided as per need of the students/staffs.
